institution_matches.overview: Proposes MGA, which organizes pretrained RL policies into structured proposal sequences and refines them via model-based rollouts on a contact-aware manifold. The method improves safety and success for contact-rich tasks like surface scanning, peg insertion, and humanoid pushing under changing contact conditions.

institution_matches.title: MoCaP: Mobile Code-as-Policies for Zero-Shot Mobile Manipulation from Passive Human Videos
institution_matches.overview: Introduces an agentic pipeline that extracts spatial memory and approach priors from passive human videos to guide a code-as-policy mobile manipulation controller. On a real mobile manipulator, MoCaP achieves 80% success on two indoor tasks and substantially boosts navigation and base-pose finding versus baselines.

institution_matches.title: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
institution_matches.overview: Presents P³-WAM, a unified video-diffusion-based model that jointly handles 3D perception, action-conditioned future prediction, and goal-directed planning for egocentric hand-object manipulation. Unified training across these modes improves 3D hand reconstruction, video prediction, and instruction-following manipulation over specialized baselines.

institution_matches.title: Auditable and Deployable Multi-Agent Motion Planning via Posetal Games from Legal Guidelines
institution_matches.overview: Formulates multi-agent motion planning under partially ordered legal guidelines as posetal games, allowing agents to reconcile private objectives with shared legal priorities. Belief play and a distributed best-response scheme recover equilibria without sharing private preferences, demonstrated on multi-vessel maritime navigation scenarios.

institution_matches.title: Illumination-Aware Active Perception for Spacecraft Inspection
institution_matches.overview: Replaces line-of-sight visibility metrics with a learned information measure from a classifier VAE to plan spacecraft inspection viewpoints under challenging orbital lighting. In simulation, the planner obtains significantly better-illuminated observations than geometric baselines while maximizing its own objective.

institution_matches.title: Asking Smarter Questions: Targeted Active Preference Learning for Underspecified Rewards
institution_matches.overview: Shows how robots can detect underspecified reward features from initial teaching data and then target preference queries toward them using an informed prior plus explanations. Simulation and user studies demonstrate up to 30.8% improved reward recovery in low-query regimes over standard active preference learning.

topic_matches.title: Spark-0: Scaling Spatially Aligned Tactile Pretraining for Robot Dexterous Manipulation
topic_matches.overview: Introduces Spark-0, a large VTLA model that uses 1,000 hours of full-hand tactile human data to supervise visual tokens and a tactile pathway for contact-rich dexterous manipulation. It sets new state of the art on SparkArena and Ego Humanoid benchmarks and shows that tactile data significantly boosts even vision-only deployment performance.

topic_matches.title: Dexterity from Supervised Play
topic_matches.overview: DSP trains a short human-play behavior-cloned policy to autonomously collect hours of contact-rich data, then uses a world model for MPC planning and self-play policy distillation. On multifingered hands, it achieves large success gains over hindsight BC and matches RL with orders-of-magnitude less interaction data.

topic_matches.title: Evo-DexBench: Benchmarking Generalization across Related Tasks for Dexterous Manipulation
topic_matches.overview: Defines the Core-Gen principle and releases Evo-DexBench, 30 dexterous tasks grouped into six functional families with 1,248 multimodal teleoperated demos. Existing methods achieve only 38.5% average success under few-shot Gen tasks, highlighting the difficulty of functional generalization even when source tasks are related.

topic_matches.title: Mem4Act: Learning Effective Latent Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
topic_matches.overview: Mem4Act learns a fixed-size latent memory optimized for long-horizon manipulation, combining multi-scale temporal aggregation, QA-style semantic supervision, and visual key-frame reconstruction. It attains state-of-the-art success on memory-dependent benchmarks and real tasks, with ablations validating each component.

topic_matches.title: TS-WAM: Temporal Latent Actions and World-Action Coupling for Vision-Language Robot Control
topic_matches.overview: TS-WAM couples a VLM-JEPA backbone with delta latent world modeling to jointly learn latent actions, visual dynamics, and control from both robot and action-free human videos. The EMA teacher is only used during training, yielding a lightweight deployed policy that shows strong manipulation performance and robustness in sim and on Franka/RevoTron.

topic_matches.title: MOSS: Mode-Oriented Source Shaping for Robot Flow Matching Policies
topic_matches.overview: MOSS exploits the mode-dependent structure of deterministic flow trajectories by constructing mode-specific Gaussian sources in the noise space, enabling explicit behavior selection at inference. Across simulated and real manipulation tasks, it achieves near-perfect guidance to desired modes and recovers minority behaviors under severe dataset imbalance.

topic_matches.title: MAIA: Anticipating Interaction Anomalies in Contact-Rich Manipulation via Multimodal World Models
topic_matches.overview: MAIA trains a multimodal vision-action-force world model with an anomaly head that predicts impending contact anomalies before they manifest. On the CRIA dataset and real tasks, it achieves earlier and more accurate anomaly detection than baselines and raises manipulation success by using predictions for anomaly-aware action selection.

topic_matches.title: CQDC-Warp: GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Quasi-Dynamic Simulation for Contact-Rich Manipulation
topic_matches.overview: CQDC-Warp is a differentiable quasi-dynamic simulator on GPU tailored for batched MPC in contact-rich manipulation, encouraging intended contacts via soft costs without fixed contact schedules. It substantially improves success and reduces trajectory-generation time over prior planners on Allegro in-hand rotation and scales to multi-hand and whole-body cases.

topic_matches.title: TGrasp6D: Task-Informed Vision-Language Priors and Pose Refinement enable Zero-Shot Task-Oriented 6DoF Grasping
topic_matches.overview: TGrasp6D uses a VLM to infer task-specific affordances from an instruction and RGB-D input, then generates and refines 6DoF grasps that respect both object geometry and task semantics. It achieves 94% success on TaskGrasp, markedly surpassing prior task-oriented grasping baselines, and transfers zero-shot to a real Franka arm.

topic_matches.title: MoCaP: Mobile Code-as-Policies for Zero-Shot Mobile Manipulation from Passive Human Videos
topic_matches.overview: MoCaP converts passive human videos into spatial memory and approach priors that condition a code-as-policy mobile manipulation stack, coordinating navigation and tool-use primitives under the robot's kinematics. On real indoor tasks, it dramatically improves object-finding navigation and base pose reachability, yielding 80% end-to-end success.
